subject: PrimeBridge production hotpath fallout — immediate remediation + exec flag
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@primebridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeBridge Support <support@primebridge.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:43 -0700
Subject: Production: abrupt throughput collapse since model flip — urgent

Marissa —

We just observed a major drop in inference throughput (~60% overall) and a sharp rise in p95 latency (from ~320ms to ~1.8s) across our primary region about 15 minutes after the automatic model swap to the new v5.2 artifact with the new quant profile. Error rates spiked to ~4.8% (5xx and decode timeouts) and user-facing timeouts in our checkout path increased. This is impacting live transactions and several merchants are reporting failures.

Timeline:
- 08:54 PDT: Redwood reports auto-rollout to model v5.2 (quant profile q8c).
- 09:00 PDT: Our monitoring shows throughput collapse and decode timeouts.
- 09:08 PDT: Some requests started returning truncated responses / 504s.

Attached sample logs (error-sample-logs.txt) and a short metrics snapshot. Can you triage immediately and let me know the mitigation plan? If possible we need a rollback to the previous serving variant or a fallback routing step. We are preparing a customer-facing incident notice and need an ETA for remediation.

Daniel Park
Head of Platform Reliability
PrimeBridge

Attachments: error-sample-logs.txt (text), hotpath-metrics-snapshot.csv

Folks —

Forwarding PrimeBridge's alert. Key asks:
1) Confirm whether the auto-rollout to v5.2 + q8c quant profile can be reversed quickly (rollback to v5.1 pinned variant).
2) If rollback will take >15 minutes, implement traffic routing to their fallback variant or route high-priority keys to dedicated capacity.
3) Short-term mitigation: tune decode timeout, reduce max batch size for PrimeBridge tenant, and enable prefix/KV cache bypass if that's contributing to stalls.
4) Rishi: coordinate CX comms and proposed credits; customer is already seeing revenue impact.
5) Jonas: gather per-GPU stall traces and kernel-level error counts — attach to the incident.

I'm standing up an emergency bridge at 09:25 PDT. Please use the ticket INC-4521 and update the doc in the shared drive. I will brief Aditya in 20 min unless you need immediate exec escalation.

Marissa

Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: abrupt throughput collapse since model flip — triage + immediate asks

Marissa —

Prelim triage findings (first 8 minutes):
- Reproduced on our staging fleet with v5.2 + q8c when batch sizes > 6 and sequence length distribution includes many short requests: decode stalls and kernel timeouts spike.
- Root cause hypothesis: the new quant kernel (q8c) has a tight memory packing optimization that increases contention on the KV cache eviction path under mixed-size batches. Under these conditions we hit a pathological path that causes repeated small stalls and an increase in lock contention in the allocator.
- GPUs affected: A100-80G and some A30s during high-concurrency windows.

Immediate actions underway (executed at 09:20 PDT):
- Forcing a serving policy to pin PrimeBridge routing to the previous artifact (v5.1, q8b) for all regions — this is rolling now; estimate completion 10-15 minutes.
- Deploying a config to cap batch size to 4 for the PrimeBridge tenant to reduce contention while rollback completes.
- Enabling a short-circuit on KV cache population for requests with seq_len < 32 to avoid the eviction churn.

If rollback fails to restore baseline by 09:40, we prepare to open an emergency hotfix that reverts the q8c kernel change. I'll attach traces (hotpath-traces.tar) once collection completes.

Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime

Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 10:05:12 -07:00
Subject: Exec brief: PrimeBridge production hit — request for immediate approval on rollback & customer credits

Aditya —

Summary: PrimeBridge (key customer, ~4.2% of regional usage) experienced a sudden throughput collapse and increased error rates after an automatic model rollout to v5.2 with the q8c quant kernel. Engineering (Vivek) has initiated a forced pin back to v5.1; early signs show partial restoration during the 09:20-09:40 window but we need full rollback confirmation.

Impact metrics (preliminary):
- Throughput: -60% overall for PrimeBridge tenant; peak p95 latency increased to ~1.8s.
- Error rate: rose to ~4.8% (includes 5xx and timeouts) for the 09:00–09:30 window.
- Estimated lost transactions: ~13k in the first 30 minutes (customer-provided numbers).

Recommended exec approvals and asks:
1) Approve a 72-hour priority post-deploy pause for auto-rollouts across top ten customers while we complete a q-kernel compatibility sweep.
2) Approve a goodwill credit to PrimeBridge (Rishi to propose amount) and authorize customer-facing apology comms.
3) Fast-track a hotfix to revert the q8c packing change and add a stricter canary policy for mixed-batch workloads.

Next steps: we have a bridge with PrimeBridge CTO at 11:30 PDT to confirm remediation and credits. I'll provide a one-page incident brief for the board call if you want a short summary.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success

Attachments: cx-call-agenda.pdf
